description: The new Gemma prompts omit the user-turn end marker present in the existing Gemma formatter.
trigger: Format any request through the new Gemma2 or Gemma3 default_chat_prompt methods, including inherited Gemma3TextModel use.
expected_behavior: Close the user turn with <end_of_turn> before starting the model turn, as the existing PromptFormat_gemma.format does.
actual_behavior: The new methods append only a newline after user content and immediately start the model turn. A scalar transcription produced two turn starts and zero turn ends. No parent-tree callers of the new API were found; model-output consequences are untested.

verification.description: Compared the new methods with PromptFormat_gemma.format, which emits user content followed by <end_of_turn> and then the model prefix.
verification.limits: Repository-local format comparison, not checkpoint-specific template validation.

verification.description: Counted turn markers in the transcribed new construction for three system-prompt cases.
verification.limits: Checks string structure only, not tokenizer recognition or generation behavior.
